work.description: Entire CVI LF 56627–56722 plus 20 LF context read. Exact refined end 56692 retains the complete Cardinal de Bernis letter and its own separate printed dating fragment, excluding following urn act’s displaced marginal notes 56695–56719. All substantive sentences, blessing and closing proceed in order. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
